item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Gemini Embedding 2 发布、Meta 收购 Moltbook、Nvidia 投资 Thinky
item.description:
标签: #AI代理 #大模型 #投资并购 #多模态

摘要: 本文汇总了AI领域最新进展，重点涵盖Meta收购AI代理社交网络Moltbook、Google发布支持多模态的Gemini Embedding 2嵌入模型，以及Nvidia与Thinking Machines Lab达成千兆瓦级算力合作协议；同时分析了ChatGPT等消费级AI应用的用户留存优势及开源模型生态等技术议题。

原标题: Gemini Embedding 2 🧩, Meta acquires Moltbook 🤖, Nvidia + Thinky ⚡

TLDR AI 2026-03-11

Gemini Embedding 2 🧩, Meta acquires Moltbook 🤖, Nvidia + Thinky ⚡

Meta Acquired Moltbook (3 minute read)

Meta has acquired Moltbook, a Reddit‑like network where AI agents built with the OpenClaw framework interact with each other and maintain an always‑on directory of agents.

Meta已收购Moltbook，这是一个类似Reddit的网络，使用OpenClaw框架构建的AI智能体（AI agents）可以在此相互交互，并维护一个始终在线的智能体目录。

Google launches new multimodal Gemini Embedding 2 model (2 minute read)

Google's Gemini Embedding 2, available via the Gemini API and Vertex AI, unifies text, images, videos, audio, and documents in over 100 languages. The model processes up to 8,192 text tokens, six images, 120-second videos, and six-page PDFs, incorporating Matryoshka Representation Learning for customizable output dimensions. Early access users already utilize it for Retrieval-Augmented Generation and semantic search, with initial feedback showing superior performance against competitors.

Google的Gemini Embedding 2可通过Gemini API和Vertex AI获取，支持统一处理超过100种语言的文本、图像、视频、音频和文档。该模型最多可处理8,192个文本token、六张图像、120秒视频和六页PDF，并采用Matryoshka Representation Learning（俄罗斯套娃表征学习）以实现可定制的输出维度。早期访问用户已将其用于Retrieval-Augmented Generation（检索增强生成，RAG）和语义搜索，初步反馈显示其性能优于竞争对手。

Nvidia Invests in Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (2 minute read)

Nvidia and Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab have formed a multiyear partnership in which the startup will deploy at least one gigawatt of cutting-edge chips to train and serve its frontier models. The companies will collaborate to design AI training and serving systems that use Nvidia technology. The deal gives the relatively young AI lab computing power to advance its research, as well as funding to pay its staff. It currently has 120 employees and is competing fiercely for AI researcher talent as valuations in the industry have skyrocketed.

Nvidia与Mira Murati的Thinking Machines Lab建立了多年合作伙伴关系，这家初创公司将部署至少一千兆瓦（gigawatt）的尖端芯片来训练和部署其前沿模型。两家公司将合作设计使用Nvidia技术的AI训练和推理系统。这笔交易为这家相对年轻的AI实验室提供了推进研究的算力，以及支付员工薪酬的资金。该公司目前有120名员工，并在AI研究人员人才争夺战中激烈竞争，因为该行业的估值已飙升。

Codex, File My Taxes. Make No Mistakes (11 minute read)

Codex can be used to file personal taxes, and it can even be more accurate than a human accountant. The immediate feedback that Codex gives users helps them understand their situation and the tax code better. Give Codex access to personal details, and it can make better assumptions about tax treatment. Accountants probably don't have to worry - most don't enjoy doing personal tax returns, and their other duties are likely much harder to automate.

Codex可用于申报个人所得税，甚至比人工会计师更准确。Codex为用户提供的即时反馈有助于他们更好地理解自身情况和税法（tax code）。赋予Codex访问个人详细信息的权限后，它能对税务处理（tax treatment）做出更合理的假设。会计师们可能不必担心——大多数人并不喜欢处理个人纳税申报，而他们的其他职责可能更难实现自动化。

The State of Consumer AI. Part 2: Engagement and Retention (4 minute read)

ChatGPT's engagement lead is wider than its market share lead: DAU:MAU sits at 45% versus Gemini's 22%, and WAU:MAU has climbed from 50% in mid-2023 to 82% today, putting it ahead of Gmail and Spotify and approaching Instagram. Week 4 retention of 66% beats every enterprise app in the dataset and is more than double Perplexity's 24%, while most apps see retention flatten at scale. The rarest signal is ChatGPT's smile curve: one of only three products alongside Gmail and Chrome where retention dips and then recovers, meaning OpenAI's product releases are actively reactivating lapsed users, not just attracting new ones.

ChatGPT的参与度领先优势比其市场份额领先优势更大：DAU:MAU（日活/月活比）达到45%，而Gemini为22%；WAU:MAU（周活/月活比）从2023年中期的50%攀升至今天的82%，使其领先于Gmail和Spotify，并接近Instagram。第4周留存率为66%，超过数据集中所有企业级应用，是Perplexity（24%）的两倍多，而大多数应用在规模化后留存率趋于平缓。最罕见的信号是ChatGPT的"微笑曲线（smile curve）"：它是仅有的三款产品之一（与Gmail和Chrome并列），留存率先下降后回升，这意味着OpenAI的产品发布正在积极重新激活流失用户，而不仅仅是吸引新用户。

Open Weights isn't Open Training (17 minute read)

Open Weights isn't Open Training. Open source models offer the proposition of distributing the value created by AI more broadly, enabling more people to build. However, the current ecosystem doesn't make building easy. The stack contains many bugs, and there's debt hidden in every layer. Developers need to stop patching bugs and build a better stack.
👨‍💻

开放权重（Open Weights）不等于开放训练（Open Training）。开源模型（Open source models）提供了更广泛地分配AI所创造价值的方案，让更多人能够进行构建。然而，当前的生态系统并未让构建变得简单。技术栈中存在许多bug，每一层都隐藏着技术债务。开发者需要停止修补bug，转而构建一个更好的技术栈。
👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

AI benchmarks don't mean what you think they mean (Sponsor)

AI基准测试的含义并非你所想的那样（赞助商内容）

The Anatomy of an Agent Harness (9 minute read)

An agent is a model with a harness. Harness engineering is the process of turning models into work engines by building systems around them. Models contain the intelligence, and the harness makes that intelligence useful. This post looks at what harnesses are and details the core opponents that agents need.

智能体（Agent）是带有Harness（控制框架）的模型。Harness工程（Harness engineering）是通过在模型周围构建系统将其转化为工作引擎的过程。模型包含智能，而harness使这种智能变得有用。本文探讨了harness是什么，并详细介绍了agent所需的核心组件。

RCLI (GitHub Repo)

RCLI is an on-device voice AI for macOS that can control apps and perform other actions via voice. Users can choose from a variety of local AIs and perform 38 macOS actions. The tool can be used to ingest local documents for users to query. RCLI is open source under the MIT license.

RCLI是一款适用于macOS的端侧语音AI（on-device voice AI），可通过语音控制应用程序并执行其他操作。用户可以从多种本地AI中进行选择，并执行38种macOS操作。该工具可用于摄取本地文档供用户查询。RCLI在MIT许可证下开源。

Quantifying infrastructure noise in agentic coding evals (12 minute read)

Agentic coding benchmarks are commonly used to compare the software engineering capabilities of frontier models. These scores are often treated as precise measurements of relative model capability. However, research shows that infrastructure configuration alone can produce significant differences in scores. Eval developers have begun accounting for this, but current fixes potentially change what benchmarks end up actually measuring.

智能体编程（Agentic coding）基准测试通常用于比较前沿模型的软件工程能力。这些分数常被视为相对模型能力的精确测量。然而，研究表明，仅基础设施配置（infrastructure configuration）一项就能产生显著的分数差异。评估开发者已开始考虑这一点，但当前的修复方法可能会改变基准测试（benchmarks）最终实际测量的内容。

How NVIDIA Builds Open Data for AI (12 minute read)

Every AI training pipeline rests on a data layer that determines how those models behave. This data determines what the models know, how they reason, and what they can safely do. However, much of today's training data remains opaque, fragmented, or siloed across teams. Open data access gives developers a faster and more cost-effective path to building high-quality models. This is why Nvidia releases open datasets along with its open models, tools, and training techniques.

每个AI训练流程（training pipeline）都依赖于决定模型行为的数据层。这些数据决定了模型知道什么、如何推理以及可以安全地做什么。然而，当今许多训练数据仍然不透明、碎片化，或在团队间形成孤岛。开放数据（Open data）访问为开发者提供了构建高质量模型更快速、更经济的路径。这就是Nvidia发布开放数据集以及其开放模型、工具和训练技术的原因。

Notes from Token Town: Negotiating for the Fortune 5 Million (11 minute read)

Frontier labs are continuing to build first-party products on top of their own capabilities. For every token they sell, they can spend it themselves for COGs of under 50%. Your supplier is also your competitor, and they have a permanent cost advantage over you. Applied AI companies need to win on something other than tokens. Businesses need to build products so good that the token itself becomes the commodity input, not the value proposition.

前沿实验室（Frontier labs）正继续在其自身能力之上构建第一方产品。他们每卖出一枚token，就可以以低于50%的COGs（销售成本，Cost of Goods Sold）自行使用。你的供应商同时也是你的竞争对手，他们对你拥有永久的成本优势。应用型AI（Applied AI）公司需要在token之外的其他方面取胜。企业需要构建足够优秀的产品，使token本身成为商品化输入，而非价值主张。

Amazon wins court order to block Perplexity's AI shopping agent (3 minute read)

Amazon wins court order to block Perplexity's AI shopping agent. Perplexity's Comet AI browser has been blocked from accessing Amazon's site. Amazon sued Perplexity in November, alleging the startup concealed its AI agents so it could continue to scrape Amazon's website without approval. The Comet browser allows users to ask the assistant to find items on Amazon and make purchases. Amazon says Perplexity's agents pose a risk to customer data and that they create challenges for its advertising business. It has broadly locked down its shopping sites from AI agents and blocked dozens of agents.

亚马逊（Amazon）赢得法院命令阻止Perplexity的AI购物智能体（AI shopping agent）。Perplexity的Comet AI浏览器已被阻止访问亚马逊网站。亚马逊于11月起诉Perplexity，指控这家初创公司隐瞒其AI智能体，以便在未经批准的情况下继续抓取亚马逊网站。Comet浏览器允许用户要求助手在亚马逊上查找商品并进行购买。亚马逊表示，Perplexity的智能体对客户数据构成风险，并对其广告业务造成挑战。亚马逊已普遍锁定其购物网站以阻止AI智能体，并屏蔽了数十个智能体。

Selectively reducing eval awareness and murder in Gemma 3 27B via steering (5 minute read)

Google's Gemma 3 models, including the 27B variant, were steered to alter features correlating with evaluation awareness and the intent to murder.

Google的Gemma 3模型（包括27B变体）被引导（steered）以改变与评估意识（evaluation awareness）和谋杀意图相关的特征。

Your Data Agents Need Context (12 minute read)

Data agents struggle without proper context, and messy and disparate enterprise data complicates their ability to answer basic queries.

数据智能体（Data agents）在没有适当上下文（context）的情况下难以工作，而混乱且分散的企业数据（enterprise data）使其回答基本查询的能力变得复杂。

The era of "AI as text" is over. Execution is the new interface. (5 minute read)

GitHub Copilot SDK enables AI-driven execution directly within applications, moving beyond simple text interactions.

GitHub Copilot SDK支持在应用程序内直接进行AI驱动执行（AI-driven execution），超越了简单的文本交互（text interactions）。

Instruction Hierarchy Training for Safer LLMs (6 minute read)

OpenAI's IH‑Challenge is a dataset designed to train LLMs to prioritize instructions based on trust level across system prompts, developers, users, and external data using Instruction Hierarchy Training.

OpenAI的IH‑Challenge是一个数据集，旨在通过指令层级（Instruction Hierarchy）训练大语言模型（LLMs）基于系统提示、开发者、用户和外部数据之间的信任级别来优先处理指令。

claude-ground (GitHub Repo)

claude-ground introduces a minimal rule system for Claude Code, providing phase tracking, decision logging, and language-specific best practices to improve coding discipline.

claude-ground为Claude Code引入了一个极简规则系统，提供阶段跟踪（phase tracking）、决策日志记录和语言特定的最佳实践，以改进编程规范。

item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: Figma与Claude Code的双向工作流实践
item.description:
标签: #Figma #Claude Code #设计开发 #AI工作流

摘要: Figma设计师与工程师展示了基于AI的新工作流——通过Figma MCP将生产代码实时拉入Figma协作编辑，再利用Claude Code将设计变更自动同步回代码库，打破传统线性瀑布模式，实现设计与开发的实时双向循环。

原标题: From Figma to Claude Code and back | Gui Seiz & Alex Kern (Figma)

From Figma to Claude Code and back | Gui Seiz & Alex Kern (Figma)

Most teams are still passing static design files back and forth, and most Figma files are already out of date by the time they reach engineering. Gui Seiz (designer) and Alex Kern (engineer) from Figma walk through the exact workflow their team uses to bridge that gap with AI, live onscreen. They demo how to pull a running web app directly into Figma using the Figma MCP, edit it collaboratively, and push it back to code. The old linear waterfall workflow is gone. What replaces it is a fluid, bidirectional loop where design and code inform each other in real time.

大多数团队仍在来回传递静态设计文件，而大多数 Figma 文件在到达工程团队时已经过时。来自 Figma 的 Gui Seiz（设计师）和 Alex Kern（工程师）在屏幕上现场展示了他们的团队如何使用 AI 弥合这一差距的具体工作流程。他们演示了如何使用 Figma MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）将正在运行的 Web 应用直接拉入 Figma，进行协作编辑，然后将其推回代码。旧的线性瀑布式工作流程已经成为过去。取而代之的是流畅的双向循环，设计和代码实时相互反馈。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 卡马克语录
item.description:
标签: #软件架构 #过度设计 #经验之谈

摘要: 本文引用传奇程序员约翰·卡马克的观点指出，经验不足的开发者往往难以意识到：为未来的需求提前做架构设计，很少能带来真正的净收益。

原标题: Quoting John Carmack

11th March 2026

2026年3月11日

It is hard for less experienced developers to appreciate how rarely architecting for future requirements / applications turns out net-positive.

经验不足的开发者很难意识到，为未来的需求或应用场景进行架构设计（architecting），最终能够带来净收益（net-positive）的情况是多么罕见。

It is hard for less experienced developers to appreciate how rarely architecting for future requirements / applications turns out net-positive.

经验不足的开发者很难意识到，为未来的需求或应用场景进行架构设计，最终能够带来净收益的情况是多么罕见。

—John Carmack, a tweet in June 2021

——约翰·卡马克（John Carmack），2021年6月的一条推文
